summary: Frontend-only validation of 4 user-reported fixes on Expo web preview (390x844). ALL 5 scenarios PASSED. (1) /auth/register: both account-type cards (register-type-user + register-type-couple) render; selecting 'Mariés' reveals the auto-link note; registering couple-<rand>@test.fr / test1234 with 'Test Couple' + consent redirects to /profile and shows profile-project-waiting card. (2) Admin flow on Yassina & Bensaid: /admin/projects/yassina-bensaid header shows 'Compte Mariés relié — suivi visible en temps réel' (linked to maries3046@test.fr); step 'Vidage des cartes mémoire' modal opens, set-in-progress saves without error; 'Supprimer le suivi' opens branded ConfirmDialog with Annuler/Supprimer — Annuler leaves the project intact; Supprimer navigates back to /admin/projects and Yassina & Bensaid is gone from the list and stays gone after reload; candidate 'project-candidate-yassina-bensaid' re-appears in 'Mariages sans suivi actif'; recreating via new-project modal with owner email maries3046@test.fr auto-relinks the account (Compte Mariés relié shown on the recreated project). (3) Real-time couple polling: couple login → /profile shows profile-project-tracking; PATCH /api/admin/projects/yassina-bensaid/steps/card_offload → done via admin token; within ~13s the couple's profile updates to show 'Terminé' step + 11% progress WITHOUT manual reload (polling every 10s + on focus works). Step reset to pending afterwards. (4) Guestbook reveal: logged-out /guestbook/yassina-bensaid/reveal shows 'Se connecter à mon espace' (reveal-login), no code input; clicking navigates to /auth/login?redirect=%2Fguestbook%2Fyassina-bensaid%2Freveal; after login redirected back to reveal and shows 'Aucun message pour le moment' WITHOUT code input; public /guestbook/yassina-bensaid still loads for anonymous with text form + Audio/Vidéo buttons. (5) Regression /admin/auto-import loads with 'IMPORTATION AUTOMATIQUE' header and 4 stat cards. Environment restored (project renamed back to 'Yassina & Bensaid' after recreation was created with candidate-derived short name 'Yassina'; step reset to pending).

issues: Cosmetic: when re-creating a suivi from the 'Mariages sans suivi actif' candidate, wedding_name defaults to the candidate short label (e.g. 'Yassina') instead of the fuller previously-known name ('Yassina & Bensaid'). Auto-link and all functionality are unaffected. Admin can rename via project-edit-btn. Non-blocking, informational only.

action_items: None blocking. All 4 fixes verified working end-to-end on web preview.

OPTIONAL cosmetic: when recreating a suivi from a candidate, prefill wedding_name from a lookup of past deletions or from any historical alias so users don't have to re-type the full couple name. Currently the admin can edit it via project-edit-btn (verified working).
critical_code_review_comments: reveal.tsx correctly uses router.push loginHref with redirect param; after login the redirect brings the user back to /guestbook/{clientId}/reveal, then linked-couple branch reveals messages without a code — good.
profile.tsx polling (10s + on focus) is working and reflects admin step changes without manual reload — verified visually with Terminé + 11% progress after 13s.
project detail correctly shows the 'project-link-account' Relier button only when owner_user_id is missing (not shown in linked state — verified).
Branded ConfirmDialog (from src/ui) is used on Supprimer le suivi — Alert.alert web-incompat bug is fixed.
Delete guard works: after Supprimer, project stays deleted after page reload (no auto-recreation from the candidate list) — the project_tracking_deleted guard is effective.
